text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Say what?! Exercises to make you taller?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Only 30 seconds a day...!?
Well, ya just gotta do it then!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've got Part 1 down completely!
I'm gonna grow real tall!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First, a pose to cheer on my own body
so that I can grow taller!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Next, strike a model pose
to get ready for walking the runway!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"And lastly, the smile of someone who's gained
peace of mind from growing taller!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Is this really gonna make me taller?
How's that even supposed to work...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it works muscles I don't usually use,
so it might actually be surprisingly effective.
Shall we give Part 2 a shot as well?”
After making this routine a daily habit, Tamamo Cross hadn't grown any taller, but she had gained many valuable insights.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: —Wait, so your height didn't change at all!!
